result.markdown: --- title: "" --- ## Week 10 ### Day 1 #### [Today]{style="color:red;"} ##### **In Class Discussion led by Emma and DiDi** ##### **In Class Discussion of Guillera-Arroita et al. 2015** - What is a SDM? - What are they used for? - What are the types of data used and how does that change the inference/predictions? - What are the three joint probabilities that determine whether a site is recorded as a detection in a data set? - What is the difference/importance of being able to estimate occurrence probability and occurrence relative likelihood? - What are some specific model types or algorithms commonly used for fitting a SDM? #### [Assigned]{style="color:red;"} - Readings for next class: - Kery and Kellner ch20 - Manica et al. 2019 - Background Reading (not required): - Madsen and Royle 2023 - Kery 2018 - Link et al 2018 - Barker et al 2018 ### Day 2 (lab) #### [Today]{style="color:red;"} - Downloads: Files - Install R packages: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # CRAN packages install.packages(c("VGAM")) ``` ::: #### [Assigned]{style="color:red;"} - Readings for next class: - Prochazka et al. 2023
